title: WarehouseLineageRecord
description: Provisional first-class lineage schema for Warehouse canon artifacts. Every artifact family that claims canonical status must carry a lineage record conforming to this schema. Status: candidate v0.1.

artifact_id.description: Unique identifier for this artifact instance. Format: <YYYYMMDD>-<type-slug>-<short-id>.

artifact_type.description: The artifact family this record belongs to.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this artifact was first created.

created_by.description: Agent or human identifier that created this artifact.

authority_source.description: Repository-relative path to the single authoritative copy of this artifact.

version.description: Semantic version or sequential version of this artifact.

derived_from.description: Artifact IDs or paths that this artifact was derived from or supersedes.

reflection_sources.description: Paths to mirror or reflection copies of this artifact. These are not authoritative.

superseded_by.description: Artifact ID or path that supersedes this artifact, if any. Null if still active.

session.description: Session ID (from 30-sessions/) under which this artifact was created or last modified.

hash.description: SHA-256 content hash of the artifact at the time this lineage record was written. Null if not yet computed.

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes about this lineage entry.

examples.notes: Provisional candidate specification reconstructed from corpus archaeology.
